title: Add an outputer to an Output Job
summary: Opens an .OutJob as IWSM_OutputJobDocument, adds it to the focused project and creates a predefined output (PCB Print by default) for each PDF medium with CreateOutputer, then lists the job's media and outputers.
phrasings: add a PCB print output to an OutJob
create an output in an output job from code
list the media and outputs of an OutJob
add an OutJob to the current project

commands.name: CreateOutputer
commands.description: Open the OutJob, save it, add it to the focused project, then call CreateOutputer once per output medium of type MediumType; report the media and the outputers created

commands.name: ListOutputers
commands.description: List the OutJob's output media (name, type, outputers) and all its outputers
